name: meliora-backend
description: Meliora Gym - NestJS microservices (API gateway + auth, membership, class, access, notification, staff, facility, commerce, training)

scripts.build: for app in api-gateway auth-service membership-service class-service access-service notification-service staff-service facility-service commerce-service training-service workflow-service; do nest build $app || exit 1; done
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,member,class,access,notify,staff,facility,commerce,training,workflow "nest start api-gateway --watch" "nest start auth-service --watch" "nest start membership-service --watch" "nest start class-service --watch" "nest start access-service --watch" "nest start notification-service --watch" "nest start staff-service --watch" "nest start facility-service --watch" "nest start commerce-service --watch" "nest start training-service --watch" "nest start workflow-service --watch"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,member,class,access,notify,staff,facility,commerce,training,workflow "node dist/apps/api-gateway/main.js" "node dist/apps/auth-service/main.js" "node dist/apps/membership-service/main.js" "node dist/apps/class-service/main.js" "node dist/apps/access-service/main.js" "node dist/apps/notification-service/main.js" "node dist/apps/staff-service/main.js" "node dist/apps/facility-service/main.js" "node dist/apps/commerce-service/main.js" "node dist/apps/training-service/main.js" "node dist/apps/workflow-service/main.js"
